narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.

finalText:
Build passes now. You were right that it wasn't all noise — the build was actually **failing** (exit 1, `ERROR EBUILD02 link-failed`), buried under ~950 lines of log. Two sequential bugs from the bump:

1. **`src/core/options.js:6`** — the bundler renamed its option `retries` → `retryCount`; this call site still read `options.retries`, so `.toFixed()` threw on `undefined`. Now reads `retryCount` with a fallback to `retries`, and throws a clear `TypeError` on a genuinely bad value.

2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` rather than `false`; the strict check threw on that. Unset now means disabled (matching the old default); non-boolean values still error.

The remaining output is genuine noise: deprecation warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, `punycode`, etc.) plus three lint-style warnings. Two of those are worth queueing separately — `W1042` flags `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` (a real security issue, and slated for removal in v5), and `W3307` reports a circular import between `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js` with undefined resolution order. Neither breaks the build today; say the word and I'll take them on.
